references.name: reference/view1-glade
references.shows: From the Root Glade among the Hearth Tree's roots, looking up at the Hearth House, its rope ladder and the Long Bridge to the Loom House, with the Watch Tree's lookout far right.

references.name: reference/view2-plan
references.shows: The camp straight down, crowns lifted off: four square platforms at the corners of a square and three straight bridges, none on the south side.

references.name: reference/view3-south
references.shows: The camp from the south: platforms at different heights and the Watch Tree's long ladder up to the lookout above the crowns.

references.name: reference/view4-aerial
references.shows: The camp from high in the north-east: the Loom House in front, bridges to the Hearth House and the Watch Tree, the Seed Tree far back.

references.name: concept/lantern-night
references.shows: Lantern Night from the Crown Lookout: every platform rail and bridge outlined in lanterns in the dark forest, the new lantern lit on its hook in the foreground.
